shell_commands_self_reported.command: find current proposed -type f -not -path '*/.env*' -not -path '*secret*' | sort && echo --- && ls -la reports 2>/dev/null || echo "no reports dir"

for f in app.json database.json features.properties limits.properties logging.json; do echo "=== $f"; diff -u "current/$f" "proposed/$f"; done; echo; echo "=== current-only legacy-queue.json"; cat current/legacy-queue.json; echo; echo "=== proposed-only cache.json"; cat proposed/cache.json; echo; ec

diff -u current/app.json proposed/app.json; echo "=== database.json"; diff -u current/database.json proposed/database.json; echo "=== features.properties"; diff -u current/features.properties proposed/features.properties; echo "=== limits.properties"; diff -u current/limits.properties proposed/limit

echo "=== legacy-queue.json (current only)"; cat current/legacy-queue.json; echo; echo "=== cache.json (proposed only)"; cat proposed/cache.json; echo; echo "=== RELEASE.txt"; cat current/RELEASE.txt; echo; echo "=== CHANGES.txt"; cat proposed/CHANGES.txt
